common_setup.lattice: 16x16 torus; 256 cells, two reciprocal weight planes
common_setup.ports: Three protected 2x2 ports; cue port clamped, two output ports scored
common_setup.acquisition_regime: matched birth and ongoing cue noise
common_setup.probe_future_regimes: matched or independent birth AND ongoing cue noise; injury distribution unchanged

common_boundary_features.feature: Four g14 supplying-body cue/port means multiplied by the true orientation and prescribed output signs
Minimum aligned margin and its strict >.25 success indicator
Unsigned 64-step normalized cue-transfer access to the output ports
Three history indicators with one omitted reference history
Signed 64-step normalized cue transfer aligned to the true orientation

model_extra.successor32: One scalar: success fraction from 32 independent writer-then-successor-evaluation probes
model_extra.direct64: One scalar: success fraction from 64 unchanged-packet reads
model_extra.pooled32: One scalar: pooled success over 32 current-packet writer-body reads and 32 unchanged-packet evaluations
model_extra.direct8: One scalar: success fraction from first eight unchanged-packet evaluations
model_extra.tt008: No extra probe; all 11 common boundary features retained

label_access: The supplied true task orientation enters feature preprocessing, signed transfer, probe success and terminal scoring. It is not a separate numeric coefficient input; the pipeline nevertheless uses the answer. These are task-success forecasters, not label-blind orientation decoders.
record_and_body: Features combine the g14 outgoing packet with already observed g14 supplying-body responses and history. No extra current outgoing-packet read defines current_pass.
observer_and_storage: Known ports/lattice/task, trained coefficients and stored incoming packet are supplied resources; no autonomous apparatus maintenance or identity-information claim.

successor32.source: Actual eight-worker joint benchmark; audits excluded

direct64.source: Actual eight-worker joint benchmark; audits excluded

pooled32.source: Earlier four-worker standalone benchmark; audits excluded

direct8.source: Earlier four-worker standalone benchmark; audits excluded

tt008.source: Boundary/prediction CPU not separately timed; zero additional native probes

current_costs.limits: Marginal probe costs exclude shared boundary acquisition and training. Native-read equality is not equality of total application costs.

capture_accounting: The unchanged fast_reader.read_batch computes outgoing capture even on terminal evaluation reads where that output is not inherited. Count this work in future equal-total-cost comparisons.
